source: Step Up LRD Repayment schedule - Hivale case-3 Cr disb.xlsx, sheet 'LAN 1'
note: Reference schedule produced by the RM team's Step-Up LRD workbook. Three disbursements (4.0 Cr initial, +0.26 Cr, +3.0 Cr); the discounting factor is re-solved at each so the loan still closes exactly 180 months after the first due date. Interest in a disbursement month is charged on the old balance for the FULL month plus the new money for its part-period only; the new money lands in the closing POS, not the opening balance.
